welcome.label: Welcome · The Trophy Twins

parts.label: 🏆 The missing trophy
parts.title: Two trophies, one real
parts.body: The Derby trophy vanished. Two look-alikes turned up at the lost-and-found.

parts.label: ❓ The question
parts.title: Which one is real brass?
parts.body: No one is allowed to cut them open.

parts.label: 🧪 Dr. Nair’s plan
parts.title: Describe, then MEASURE
parts.body: Matter has mass and takes up space. Properties tell objects apart.

welcome.script:
(Hold up two matching cups or two matching spoons.) Twins! Could you tell which one is which with just your eyes?

[ON SCREEN: The missing trophy]
The Duck Derby trophy vanished, and TWO matching trophies turned up at the Palmetto Springs lost-and-found.

[ON SCREEN: The question]
One is real brass. One is painted plastic. Nobody may cut them open.

[ON SCREEN: Dr. Nair’s plan]
Dr. Nair says eyes can tie, but measurements don’t. Read her case file just below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · the bottle that fights back (Clue 1)

parts.label: 🧴 The squeeze test
parts.title: The bottle fights back
rows: Cap ON: drag down and squeeze

warmup.script:
(Hold up an empty plastic bottle, cap on tight, and try to crush it.) It fights back! (Uncap it and crush it flat.) Now it gives right up.

[ON SCREEN: The squeeze test]
Try it on the page. Cap on: drag down on the bottle. Cap off: squeeze again. Your squeeze log fills in.

[ON SCREEN: Think about it]
The bottle looked empty. So what pushed back? Answer, and Clue one is yours.

part1.label: Part 1 · the matter gates (Clue 2)

parts.label: 🚪 The matter gates
parts.title: Two tests, two gates
rows: Gate 2: does it take up space?

parts.label: 🌑 The tricky ones
parts.title: A shadow and a bell’s ring

part1.script:
(Point at your own shadow on the wall.) Is my shadow STUFF? Hmm. We don’t guess in the Field Station. We test.

[ON SCREEN: The matter gates]
Send a rock, water, air, a shadow and a bell’s ring through the machine. Gate one: does it have mass? Gate two: does it take up space? Pick the proof at each gate.

[ON SCREEN: The tricky ones]
The shadow and the ring might surprise you. Then stay for a wow: we weigh AIR.

part2.label: Part 2 · tell the twins apart (Clue 3)
part2.script:
(Hold up the two matching cups again, one in each hand, and move them up and down like a balance.) Eyes say they match. My hands aren’t sure…

[ON SCREEN: The twin jars]
Dr. Nair keeps twin practice jars. Try all four tools on them. Looking, feeling, even the ruler can tie. Watch which tool finally breaks the tie, and which KIND of property it measures.

explore.label: Part 3 · the weigh and dunk test (Clue 4)

parts.label: ⚖️ Weigh it
parts.title: Read the balance
rows: Put each trophy on the balance

parts.label: 💧 Dunk it
parts.title: Read the water line
rows: Hold it under with the rod
How far did the water climb?

explore.script:
(Pretend to lower something gently into a fish tank.) When a thing goes under, the water has to move over. The water line climbs exactly as much space as the thing takes up!

[ON SCREEN: Weigh it]
Put each trophy on the balance and read its mass.

[ON SCREEN: Dunk it]
Then hold each one under the water and read the climb. Fill both property cards. Same space, different mass. That’s Clue four, the big one.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: Which trophy is real?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues. Then the engraver’s sealed note opens.

parts.label: ✍️ Your case report
parts.title: Three places to work
rows: Property cards for two home objects

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
Four clues, two trophies, one answer. Pick the one that fits every clue, and the engraver’s sealed note opens to check your work.

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Then two short answers. For Part C, pick two look-alike objects at home and make a property card for each. Then sketch and label it. Last comes your CER about air.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “Air doesn’t take up space because you can’t see it.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
(Hold up the capped bottle one more time and squeeze.) Remember what pushed back?

[ON SCREEN: The claim]
A classmate says air takes up no space because you can’t see it. You tested that twice today: the bottle, and the balloon on the scale.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts. Then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…”

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 🏆 Your specimen
parts.title: The derby trophy
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ➡ Next lesson
parts.title: Classify by properties
parts.body: Sort materials and pick the right one for a job.

closing.script:
(Hold an invisible trophy high, then set it down proudly.) The winner finally gets the REAL trophy, thanks to you.

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and the derby trophy goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Next lesson]
Next time: you’ll use properties to sort materials, and to pick the right one for a job.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
